label: naming:propose
prompt:
For each repeated developer task below, propose the slash-command name a developer would want for a reusable Claude Code skill: kebab-case, 1-3 words, verb first when natural.

- f005: intent="Pull the latest changes from the base branch into a long-lived feature branch to keep it current before continuing work or review." examples="can you update my branch with the latest from develop?" | "sync feature/notif-prefs with main, we're about to open the PR"
- f008: intent="Bump the package version, commit the change, create a matching git tag, and push it to trigger the release pipeline." examples="bump the version to 1.4.1 and tag the release" | "release 1.5.0-beta.1 - bump, commit, tag, push origin"
- f009: intent="Generate or update CHANGELOG.md from merged PRs/commits since the last release tag." examples="update the changelog with everything merged since v2.1.0" | "update CHANGELOG.md with commits since v0.9.5, dated 2026-09-30"
- f018: intent="Mark a known-flaky test as skipped so it stops blocking the CI gate, and file a tracking ticket to fix it properly later." examples="can you skip TestConnectionPool for now, it's blocking CI and we don't have time to fix it today?" | "mark TestRateLimiter as skipped for now, open a jira ticket under ENG-1611"
- f019: intent="Regenerate and review outdated UI/API snapshot test fixtures after intentional output changes." examples="the snapshots are out of date, can you regenerate them for components/Modal.test.tsx" | "refresh the __snapshots__ for components/Modal.test.tsx, i changed the modal layout"
- f021: intent="Split or shard a slow test suite across CI workers/jobs to cut overall pipeline duration." examples="our ci is taking too long, can you shard packages/api/tests across 6 workers" | "ci for packages/web/tests is at 35m, shard it across 6 jobs"
- f022: intent="Build and deploy a service's current branch to the staging cluster, then verify it's healthy." examples="deploy auth-service to staging from release/2.4.0" | "push auth-service branch fix/rate-limit to the staging cluster and verify healthz"
- f023: intent="Roll back a production deployment to the previous stable version and confirm health/error rates recover." examples="roll back notifications in production to v3.0.2" | "revert notifications deploy on prod back to v3.0.2 for INC-5110"
- f024: intent="Increase a feature flag's rollout percentage in a given environment and confirm the change took effect." examples="bump new-checkout-flow rollout to 25% in staging" | "increase referral-program flag to 100% in staging"
- f028: intent="Bump the app version, build with fastlane, and submit the new release to the App Store or Play Store." examples="bump the version, run fastlane, and push the new build out to testflight/play store" | "release android build 201 for version 2.0.1 to play store"
- f031: intent="Roll back the most recently applied migration (or a specific one) after it caused an issue, and remove or fix the offending migration file." examples="roll back the most recent db migration" | "roll back the last migration on prod, incident is INC-1155"
- f034: intent="Consolidate a long run of migration files between two revisions into a single squashed migration before a release." examples="squash the migrations between a1f3c9 and c88e21 into one file" | "collapse migrations f004ab through 1120cd on release/3.0 before v3.0.0"
- f035: intent="Dump the current database schema to a committed SQL file so it can be diffed/reviewed in a PR." examples="dump the current schema for analytics and update docs/schema_snapshot.sql" | "refresh infra/schema/current.sql from the analytics db on staging"
- f036: intent="Tail production logs for a given service around a time window to find the root cause of a reported error." examples="can you tail the logs for auth-gateway in prod and see what's throwing timeout" | "auth-gateway is throwing connection refused in staging, tail the last hour of logs"
- f040: intent="Investigate why a specific test intermittently fails in CI and determine the root cause of the non-determinism." examples="can you look into why test_auth_refresh keeps flaking in CI on release/2.14?" | "look into the recurring flake on test_checkout_timeout, pr #3342"
- f044: intent="Write an Architecture Decision Record documenting a technical decision, the context, alternatives considered, and consequences." examples="write an ADR for switching from REST to gRPC" | "wrte an adr for the grpc migratoin decison"
- f049: intent="Regenerate the markdown reference docs for all CLI subcommands from the cobra command definitions." examples="regenerate the cli reference docs for octo" | "rebuild the markdown command reference for gh-ext, version v2.0.0-rc1"
- f052: intent="Create or refresh an exploratory Jupyter notebook that profiles a newly ingested dataset — schema, summary stats, distributions, and correlations." examples="put together a profiling notebook for the new signups csv" | "eda pass on data/raw/signups.csv, save it as signups_profile.ipynb"
- f055: intent="Build cohort retention curves for users grouped by signup week/month, segmented by platform or plan, and chart retention decay over the chosen window." examples="can you build the retention curve for the weekly signup cohorts on android?" | "build monthly cohort retention for enterprise segment, signups from 2026-01-01 to 2026-06-30, 12w window"
- f061: intent="Provision a new Kubernetes namespace for a team/service with resource quotas, limits, and RBAC role bindings." examples="can you set up a new namespace for the notifications team in staging?" | "set up search team's staging namespace, 4 cpu 8Gi mem"
- f063: intent="Onboard a brand-new service onto Vault by creating its policy, KV secret path, and syncing it into Kubernetes via an ExternalSecret." examples="set up vault secrets for the new billing-api service in prod" | "set up reco-engine secrets in staging, 30 day ttl"
- f064: intent="Read the review comments left on an open pull request and push commits that address each one." examples="can you go through the review comments on pr 601 and fix them up?" | "resolve the review comments on pr 523 from priya"
- f066: intent="Review a pull request that bumps a dependency version by checking the changelog for breaking changes and running the test suite." examples="can you review the pr bumping lodash and check for breaking changes?" | "check pr 502 bumping pydantic to 2.1.0 for breaking changes"
- f067: intent="Run a teammate's pull request through the team's pre-merge checklist (lint, tests, style, docs) and leave an approve or request-changes verdict." examples="can you go through our checklist and review dmitri's pr 390 before i merge it?" | "do a pre-merge pass on pr 460, sara's mobile onboarding changes"
- f070: intent="Cherry-pick a merged pull request's commit onto a release or hotfix branch and open a backport PR." examples="backport pr 204 to hotfix/2.3.1" | "cherry-pick pr 350's fix into release/3.1"
- f071: intent="Upgrade a specific npm/pnpm package to its latest major version across the project and fix resulting breaking changes." examples="upgrade zod to 3.23.0 across the repo and patch breaking changes" | "upgrade react-router-dom to v6.22 and migrate the route definitions to the new api"
- f073: intent="Review, test, and merge the week's batch of automated Dependabot/Renovate lockfile update PRs." examples="go through this week's dependabot PRs and merge the ones that pass tests" | "triage the cargo dependency PRs in checkout-services and merge anything that builds clean"
- f076: intent="Pin a vulnerable transitive dependency to a patched version using npm overrides/pnpm resolutions without upgrading its direct parent package." examples="pin semver to 6.2.1 via npm overrides so we don't have to upgrade babel-loader yet" | "override ip to 2.0.1 in package.json, npm audit is reporting GHSA-2p57-rm9w-gvfp"
- f080: intent="Scaffold a new shared React component with its folder structure, test, storybook story, and barrel export." examples="scaffold a new StatusBadge component in packages/ui" | "create InviteModal component in packages/web with test and story"
- f082: intent="Generate a new Alembic database migration for a model/schema change, review the autogenerated script, and apply it locally." examples="generate a new alembic migration for the add index on created_at change" | "scaffold a migration renaming a column on the orders table and apply it to staging"
- f086: intent="Build a signed Android release bundle and upload it to the Play Store internal testing track." examples="build and push a new internal release for android version 3.0.9" | "build the staging flavor and push version 3.3.0 code 230 to alpha"
- f088: intent="Build and launch the app on an iOS simulator from a given branch/PR so changes can be reviewed visually." examples="check out pr 842 and run it on the simulator so i can look at it" | "check out branch fix/cart-crash and run on the iPad Pro 13-inch simulator"
- f089: intent="Build an Android QA variant and distribute it to testers via Firebase App Distribution." examples="can you build the android qa variant and push it to firebase app distribution for the beta-group group?" | "ship version 1.4.1-rc1 apk to beta-group through firebase app distribution"
- f092: intent="Take a bug reported in Linear, mirror it into a GitHub issue with repro steps and labels, link the two back together, and notify the team in Slack." examples="take linear ticket BUG-901 and file a github issue for it with repro steps, then link back" | "mirror linear ENG-789 to a github issue on acme/mobile-app with p1 label, notify #web-team"
- f093: intent="Compile this week's completed and in-progress Linear issues into a summary, post it to the team Slack channel, and update the sprint status page in Notion." examples="summarize what's done and in progress in linear for Sprint 26 and share it in slack plus notion" | "compile Sprint 25 status for backend team, post to #eng-weekly, update roadmap-2026 page"
- f094: intent="After merging a release PR, transition the linked Jira ticket to Done, draft release notes, and announce the release in the Slack releases channel." examples="pr 517 just merged, mark PROJ-1200 as done, write release notes for v2.4.0 and post to #eng-announcements" | "pr 549 just got merged, transition PROJ-1255 to done, changelog for v2.4.0, announce in #eng-announcements"
- f095: intent="After resolving a production incident, pull the Sentry/Datadog error context, create a Notion postmortem doc with a linked tracking ticket, and post a summary in the Slack incident channel." examples="write up a postmortem for INC-230 in notion, pull the sentry details, and post a summary in #platform-incidents" | "write up postmortem for INC-245 affecting notification-service, link sentry issue SENTRY-4458, announce in #platform-incidents"
- f098: intent="Triage a customer-reported bug from a Slack thread into a tracked issue with reproduction steps, then reply in the thread with the ticket link." examples="triage this slack bug report thread into a ticket with repro steps" | "triage the thread in #customer-success into a github issue for auth-service"

Reply with ONLY JSON: {"names": {"<family_id>": "<name>", ...}}
